verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a local inference server like LocalAI, but the evidence pack never mentions memory locking, mmap, or any per-model low-level engine parameter overrides. The nearest items, --external-grpc-backends and PRELOAD_MODELS, are related CLI options rather than engine-tuning controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can override low-level engine settings like memory locking or mmap behavior instead of being limited to opinionated defaults
